line: You a ghost, fuck around wit them fuck-arounds You can fuck around, get smoked
vault_lines: You a ghost, fuck around wit them fuck-arounds
meaning:
This line is very similar to the chorus of “Get Smoked” by Lil Mouse. Vic is very loyal to his hometown of Chicago (even getting a tattoo to prove it!), so it makes sense he would support and reference a local artist like Mouse.

Fuck around with them fuck-arounds
And you fuck around and get smoked

line: You fools at FOX News Couldn’t walk a block in our shoes, they’ll lay you
meaning:
Vic Mensa hates the media coverage that put real struggles out of mind. FOX News is actually one of them typical about sports, internet viral videos, also worldwide news and some local interviews but nothing important like kids drinking unclean water or people being killed just for being black, as he said many times.

In 2017, FOX seems to concentrate many rappers anger toward it, including Kendrick Lamar who references sevral times to the media on DAMN.

It reminds another Kendrick’s line from his 2011 Poe Man’s Dreams from  Section.80 :

So won’t you bear witness
While I bare feet
So you can walk in my shoes
And get to know me

line: Let me show you how the jungle feel Lions, tigers, bears (Oh my)
vault_lines: Let me show you how the jungle feel
meaning:
This line serves as a reference to the 1930’s film The Wizard of Oz. During that movie, the main characters Dorothy, Toto, Scarecrow, and Tin-Man enter the forest and talk about the dangers that lurk within using similar language.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-HrfbV16-FQ
Vic uses this iconic line to show that Chicago is as scary, if not scarier, as this fictional forest. The only difference is that Vic’s jungle is his daily life, and his  life is always at risk.

line: Two niggas in a black Toyota With a strap that’s loaded and I can’t control ’em Ready for a game of Texas Hold’Em Meaning they ain’t no joker And they might poke ya for that white Sammy Sosa
vault_lines: Two niggas in a black Toyota
meaning:
Texas Hold'Em is a card game, a sub genre of poker.  The Joker card would give you an advantage in a game of Hold'Em. Vic uses this analogy as a way to illustrate how his acquaints were giving an disadvantage in life, so they shouldn’t be taken as a joke, they will go by any means necessary to make a living.

Samuel Kelvin Peralta Sosa was a Dominican-American baseball player. In urban vernacular referring  to cocaine as any white celebritie or as just “white girl” is used as a simile for the white powdered drug.  Sammy Sosa admittedly bleached his skin back in 2009, and made headlines  yet again in the summer of 2017 for going even further with his bleaching.





These lines tie in with the third verse on the previous track “Heaven On Earth” in which Vic Mensa’s friend Killa Cam was shot in a robbery gone wrong for 10 pounds of an undisclosed drug by a young gang member.

line: Beat a nigga like a 808, so heartless
vault_lines: Beat a nigga like a 808, so heartless
meaning:
808 is the penal (criminal) code for disturbing peace which also refers to 808s, the sound of bass coming from a stereo.

Vic also nods to Kanye’s 2008 classic album 808s & Heartbreak as well as Ye’s song “Heartless” which was also on the album.

line: Tryna dodge the feds (Watch out) If the National Guard was actually hard They wouldn’t be scared (Southside)
meaning: On January 24th, 2017, Donald Trump tweeted that he would send federal help to Vic Mensa, Joey Purp, and Chief Keef’s hometown of Chicago due to the outrageous violence and homicide rate in Chicago’s Southside.  He again tweeted about sending help on June 30th of 2017, but still the National Guard has yet to show up and actually make any changes.
